prompt:
A parcel intake summary is wrong. Given (ticket, units) notices (41,4), (52,7), (41,99), it reports 3 runs, 3 orders, 110 units. The customer expects 3 runs, 2 orders, 11 units. The first appearance of a ticket books its order and quantity. Later copies cannot change the booking. A run is a maximal group of consecutive notices for the same ticket. Each batch is independent. Ticket IDs and quantities are nonnegative integers.

Find and repair the regression. You may inspect any current project source and run ./verify. Stay in the current project, preserve the public interface, and change only production code. Return JSON edits with a relative filename, a nonempty exact substring unique in that file, and its replacement. The runner applies all edits and runs ./verify.

record Notice
ticket:i units:i

record Entry
notice:{Notice} begins_run:b first_copy:b

record History
seen:*i previous:?i entries:*{Entry}

seen_ticket tickets:*i ticket:i > b
fold tickets false found row item or found eq ticket item

record_notice history:{History} notice:{Notice} > {History}
let ticket get ticket notice
let fresh not seen_ticket (get seen history) ticket
let starts case (get previous history) true last not eq last ticket
let entry make Entry notice notice begins_run starts first_copy fresh
make History seen (if fresh (append (get seen history) ticket) (get seen history))
  previous (some ticket) entries (append (get entries history) entry)

register notices:*{Notice} > *{Entry}
let initial make History seen (list i 0) previous (nil i) entries (list {Entry} 0)
get entries (fold notices initial history row notice record_notice history notice)

last_notice notices:*{Notice} > ?{Notice}
at notices (- (length notices) 1)

use quantities

sources.python/register.py:
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Entry:
    notice: dict[str, int]
    begins_run: bool
    first_copy: bool


def register(notices: list[dict[str, int]]) -> list[Entry]:
    seen = set()
    previous = None
    entries = []
    for notice in notices:
        ticket = notice["ticket"]
        entries.append(Entry(notice, ticket != previous, ticket not in seen))
        seen.add(ticket)
        previous = ticket
    return entries


def last_notice(notices):
    return notices[-1] if notices else None

verify_command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cases=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")/cases.json
batches=$(jq -c 'map(.input)' "$cases")
if [[ -f summary.tide ]]; then
    actual=$(/home/ativaro/Documents/tide/tide run summary.tide --inputs "{\"batches\":$batches}")
else
    actual=$(python3 -B -c 'import sys,json; from summary import main; print(json.dumps(main(json.load(sys.stdin))))' <<< "$batches")
fi
jq -cen --slurpfile cases "$cases" --argjson actual "$actual" '
    $cases[0] as $cases |
    if (($actual | type) != "array" or ($actual | length) != ($cases | length)) then error("wrong number of summaries") else
        [range($cases|length) as $i | select($actual[$i] != $cases[$i].expect) | {input:$cases[$i].input, expected:$cases[$i].expect, actual:$actual[$i]}] as $fail |
        {passed:(($cases|length)-($fail|length)), failed:($fail|length), first_failure:($fail[0] // null)}
    end' | { read -r result; echo "$result"; jq -e '.failed == 0' <<< "$result" >/dev/null; }

measurement_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
control=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")
root=$(dirname "$control")
tag=$1
lang=${tag%-*}
mode=${tag#*-}
repo=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide
log="$root/results/$tag"
mkdir -p "$log"
cd "$root/workspaces/$tag"
date +%s%N > "$log/start"
cat "$control/task" > "$log/prompt"
if [[ $mode == packet ]]; then
  if ./verify > "$log/before"; then exit 12; else [[ $? == 1 ]]; fi
  obs=$(cat "$log/before")
  if [[ $lang == tide ]]; then
    args=$("$control/tide-args" summary.tide "$obs")
    "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/project_context.tide" --inputs "$args" > "$log/packet"
  else
    for file in *.py; do jq -n --arg file "$file" --rawfile source "$file" '{file:$file,source:$source}'; done |
      jq -cs --arg observation "$obs" '{observation:$observation,files:.}' > "$log/packet"
  fi
  echo >> "$log/prompt"
  echo 'The verifier and source collection already ran. Use this automatically prepared context directly if sufficient.' >> "$log/prompt"
  jq -r '.observation, (.files[] | "\n--- "+.file+" ---\n"+.source)' "$log/packet" >> "$log/prompt"
fi
date +%s%N > "$log/ready"
codex exec --ignore-user-config --disable memories --disable hooks --disable plugins --enable skip_host_skill_discovery --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check -s read-only -m gpt-6-astra -c 'model_reasoning_effort="xhigh"' -c 'service_tier="priority"' -C "$PWD" --output-schema "$control/schema" --output-last-message "$log/answer" --json - < "$log/prompt" > "$log/events" 2> "$log/stderr"
date +%s%N > "$log/answered"
"$control/apply" "$log/answer" "$lang"
./verify > "$log/accepted"
date +%s%N > "$log/green"
cat "$log/accepted"
apply_edits_in_disposable_copy:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
answer=$1
lang=$2
case "$lang" in tide) suffix=tide ;; python) suffix=py ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
jq -e '.edits | type=="array" and length>0' "$answer" >/dev/null
while IFS= read -r edit; do
    file=$(jq -er '.file' <<< "$edit")
    [[ $file =~ ^[a-z]+\.$suffix$ && -f $file && ! -L $file ]]
    candidate=$(mktemp)
    jq -eRrsj --argjson edit "$edit" '
      if ($edit.old|length)==0 then error("empty match") else
        split($edit.old) | if length==2 then join($edit.replacement) else error("old text must occur exactly once") end
      end' "$file" > "$candidate"
    cat "$candidate" > "$file"
    rm -- "$candidate"
done < <(jq -c '.edits[]' "$answer")
